'''''Guild''''' was a pair of [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They, along with sister group ''[[Trail]]'', were part of the defence against an attack by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on a Rebel installation comprised of parked [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] whose pilots were being delivered by [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]] ''[[T-DP]]'', four [[Class-C cargo container]]s ''[[Berm]]'', [[Class-B cargo container]] ''[[Clip]]'', and [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transports]] ''[[Goode]]''. The shuttles were destroyed in the battle, along with the entire installation.

The events surrounding the battle were recorded and recreated in the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]], one of them was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
